about_the_game:
Voidwatch is a fast-paced top-down space shooter with silky smooth movement. Hop from planet to planet, facing off against the Cult of the Void as you fight to free the galaxy from their clutches. Collect new weapons and powerful modifications to improve your Voidhawk Infiltrator starship & lay waste to your foes.

Story

The year is 2365. Massive technological advancements have brought an era of relative peace. That is, of course, until man's ambition once again caught up to him. During experimentation with a strange new energy, Void Energy, humanity weakened the veil between this world and another, and horrifying beings were brought into this reality. These Voidborne Gods twisted the minds of billions, creating a mighty cult that has claimed control over huge swathes of the galaxy.

You are a member of Voidwatch, an elite military force tasked with pushing back and eliminating the void threat. Though cult-controlled worlds are heavily defended, Voidwatch has a secret weapon: The Voidhawk Infiltrator. Using Void-shifting technology, the infiltrator can slip past the cult's orbital cannons. Your objective is to excise these worlds of cultist influence and clear the way for the rest of the Voidwatch fleet.
